$comment: Herds and stampedes v1 (spec pass S2 draft, 2026-11-07; docs/design/spec-s2-armies.md section 11). DRAFT: new file for data/rules. Integers only: mm, mm/s, cd, ticks at 20 per second, permille, fear 0-1000, health points. Settled from the brief: herds roam and block (2026-10-08); fear sources spook a herd into a stampede that flees the fear, steered by terrain, never aimed, picking no side (2026-10-08); herds never walk into lethal cells (2026-10-09); units herd at walking pace and never start a stampede (2026-10-09). Animals never die (decision D6). Fear is the largest of the sources, recomputed each field step; linear falloff from full at fullWithinMm to 0 at zeroAtMm. Reaching thresholdFear commits the herd: agitated (mill, dust) for agitationTicks, then stampede. Steering: lookAheadMm, turnStepCd toward lower cost (left on ties), downhill bias. Run ends after runMaxMm or runMaxTicks; the herd then scatters and never stampedes again. Animal type: unit-types.json cattle. Numbers are proposals.
